ratio 1.333 · --as-scale-ratio

A perfect fourth is a large jump on purpose: the hierarchy is unmistakable and fewer levels are needed to express it. Literata carries an optical-size axis from 7 to 72, so the letterforms are redrawn for the size rather than scaled, and browsers apply that automatically.
